plain: A well-known skeptic, Michael Shermer, in a 2026 debate with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that MK Ultra, a secret US government programme of the 1950s to 1970s that experimented with mind control, came out of fear that America was losing a race with the Russians on mind control. He offers it as an example of how secret programmes grew out of Cold War worries.
